briefdescription.para: Integrity verification, Merkle structures, and receipt semantics for distributed tensor artifacts.

detaileddescription.para: This header defines the integrity and verification model for distributed tensor artifacts, including Merkle-compatible fragment verification and receipt-chain-aligned metadata.

Purpose: Distributed tensor artifacts must be verifiable across shards and across rebuild workflows. This module provides cryptographic verification hooks for detecting corruption, verifying fragment membership, proving package lineage, and supporting audit trails.

listitem.para: Merkle tree structures for fragment-level verification
Receipt-chain semantics compatible with package lineage tracking
Provenance verification hooks and audit trail support
Verification state machine and failure handling
All integrity metadata is manifest-embedded (no separate verification storage)
Merkle proofs are lazily computed on demand (not pre-stored)
Receipt chains link to package lineage, not isolated artifact chains
Verification state is ephemeral; artifacts are trusted until proven otherwise
Corruption detection is automatic on load; tampering requires active verification
